Grade: Grade 4
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.1: Whole Numbers

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Whole Numbers

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Learning Whole Numbers

• Read the meaning of Whole Numbers.
• Copy every worked example into your book.
• Then solve the Try this questions without looking.

▸ Whole Numbers

Teach
• Use objects, drawings, or place value to understand Whole Numbers.
• Write each step. Box the final answer.

Worked example
• Model question on Whole Numbers: write the question.
• Step 1: …
• Step 2: …
• Answer: …
• (Your teacher/parent can replace this with the class example.)

Try this
• Invent 3 Whole Numbers questions using Kenyan shillings, metres, or classroom counts.
• Solve all three and show working.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Show working for one Whole Numbers question.
• Check with a second method.

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Solve 8 practice questions on Whole Numbers.
2. Mark and correct mistakes.

SECTION: REMEMBER
